mapper.sql: c.id, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_category AS courseCategory, c.course_description AS courseDescription, c.cover_image AS coverImage, c.syllabus, c.total_hours AS totalHours, c.target_audience AS targetAudience, c.prerequisites, c.default_instructor_id AS defaultInstructorId, default_user.real_name AS defaultInstructorName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT instructor_user.real_name ORDER BY instructor_user.real_name SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_course_instructor relation JOIN t_user instructor_user ON instructor_user.id = relation.instructor_id WHERE relation.course_id = c.id AND instructor_user.is_deleted = 0) AS instructorNames, c.skill_indicators AS skillIndicators, c.scoring_rules AS scoringRules, c.status, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM t_course c LEFT JOIN t_user default_user ON default_user.id = c.default_instructor_id
c.is_deleted = 0
AND (c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.course_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.course_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND c.status = #{status}
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT FROM t_course c LEFT JOIN t_user default_user ON default_user.id = c.default_instructor_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_deleted = 0
